inventory_summary: Area D2 (construction set: elevations, sections, details). Opened every one of the 59 listed sheets in permit_set_full.pdf (pages 21, 34-40, 48-66, 82-90, 101-110, 136-148): S-501.1; A-201..A-204; A-301/.1/.2; A-501..A-511 (authored details); A-512/.1/.2, A-513/.1/.2, A-514, A-515 (derived opening details); A-531..A-539 (ridge beam, stack shelves); A-550..A-559 (interior stack shelf, rim bands, plant rim); A-585..A-590 (wall on foundation); A-591..A-597 (rake, eave, garage eave, partition eaves). 15 prior ids re-probed (closed 10, partial 5, open 0, regressed 0, obsolete 0). 12 new findings. Dimensions cross-checked to model.json: elevation datum rungs, A-501/A-503 heights, A-505 bench heights/widths, A-508/A-509 riser arithmetic, A-535/A-557 court footing 4+6+10 = 20 in, A-559 floor band 1'-0 5/8" (11 7/8" + 3/4"), door ROs 82.875 in = 6'-10 7/8" (A-513/A-515), garage footing 20 x 8 in. Round-1 REPORT item 4 (detail dimensions/enlarged parts): resolved for A-501..A-510 and A-512.1/.2, A-513.1/.2 (A-507 now has tub 1'-8 1/8", valve 2'-6", integral surround and the VALVE (BEYOND) box); A-511 and the stack/rim sheets keep only the stack strings. Item 5 (plant-room rim): resolved, 5 of 5 PLANT-keyed rim sheets (A-559, A-562, A-575, A-580, A-584) now resolve to TR-CATLIN-PLANT-RIM (A-559 read in full: plant notes K1/K2/K4/K8 and the humid-membrane ladder; the other four read by transition name only, being F3's sheets), and A-581 resolves to TR-CATLIN-SAUNA-RIM; no PLANT key prints the generic band. Other reviewers' reports, confirmed once: label overprints on A-585/A-586/A-588/A-589 (caption/FTG line under the K2/K5 bubbles, 4" CI box over leaders) CONFIRMED, A-561 not in my list; A-502 draws no truss CONFIRMED (the cut at y=16' shows only the subfloor strip, the ceiling strip and the '1'-0 5/8" truss' dimension across empty paper; F3-104); A-513/A-513.1/A-513.2 draw a 6'-10 7/8" door with threshold dimensions but print the window key notes and omit the 'R.O. HEIGHTS IN THIS ASSEMBLY' line CONFIRMED (O5-103); A-301 levels rounded to the inch CONFIRMED (printed -1'-1" basement plate vs -12.625 in = -1'-0 5/8"; -9'-1" floor vs -9'-1 7/16"; second plate 19'-0" vs 19'-0 1/8"; while the rung dimensions beside them are exact: 10'-0 3/4", 8'-0 7/8"; F3-106). Product truth: this area quotes catalog and note values rather than owning products; manufacturer sections (Metal Sales Image II, Drutex/Andersen frames, Simpson hardware) were not re-sourced here (their areas own them). NOT examined: PDF vector-level geometry (no per-line extraction; dimension arrow extents were read from 100-300 dpi renders, +-3 px); the 24x36 permit_set.pdf (only the reduced ledger permit_set_full.pdf snapshot was read; the clipped titles/index may fit on 24x36); haus render/print were not run so no re-render after any proposed fix; A-505/A-506 bench and heater dimensions vs the sauna notes beyond arithmetic; A-511 gutter projection '4 1/2"' (measured 4.2 +- 0.2 in off the render, inconclusive); A-512/A-513 window frame/shim values vs the Drutex/Andersen catalogs (O4); A-504 '1'-6 3/4" plate to ridge' source (D2-110, low confidence); fascia/eave layer thicknesses on A-591..A-593 (E1/F4).

findings.title: A-514 general notes contradict the model and A-590/A-593: stem footing '12"x6"', 'OSB deck', slab '3,500 psi min'

evidence.measured: A-514 (p65) prints 'Stem footing: 12"x6" over compacted stone', 'Slab: 3-1/2" min, 3,500 psi min' and 'Roof: gable trusses ... OSB deck'. Model (model.json solids): FT-GF-S1/E footing assembly FOOTING_STONE_20, outline 20.0 in wide, z -84.0..-76.0 = 8.0 in thick (consolidated crushed stone, bearing -7'-0"); A-590 (p141) prints 'FTG 1'-8" x 8" ... BRG EL. -7'-0"'. SL-G-FLOOR is 3.5 in on EXPOSED_MIX = 5,000 psi F3/W1/C2 (mixes.py:75-80). Garage roof deck is 19/32" Structural I plywood (A-593 note 'Deck: 19/32" Structural 1 plywood (40/20)'; plans/TODO.md:303). So one sheet says 12x6 and another 20x8, one says OSB and another Structural I plywood, and the slab note quotes the code floor, not the pour spec.
evidence.expected: A-514 general notes state what A-590/A-593/S-100 state: 20"x8" crushed-stone strip footing (R403.5), slab 3-1/2" at the EXPOSED_MIX 5,000 psi, 19/32" Structural I plywood deck.
evidence.method: python: json.load(baseline/model.json); S={s['tag']:s for s in solids}; FT-GF-S1 outline bbox 27x20 in (corner) / FT-GF-E 20x288, z0/z1 -84/-76 in; SL-G-FLOOR z -37.5..-34.0. pdftotext -f 65 -l 65 permit_set_full.pdf vs -f 141 and -f 144. grep OSB in full text: only A-514.

findings.title: K7 on A-515, A-588 and A-589 says the veneer cavity is '4" clear air' / '2" EPS, 4" air'; the same sheets' ladders (and the 2026-11-04 measurement) say 1 15/16" of air and no EPS

Their own ladders print 'brick 3 5/8", xps-b 2", air-gap 1 15/16", xps-a 2"'. envelope_masonry.py:57 BASEMENT_BRICK_VENEER air-gap = 1.94 in 'MEASURED, NOT CHOSEN (2026-11-04)'. sunken_garden_veneer_beam.md s6k table (line 905-925): backup foam 4" XPS + 2" EPS (old) -> 4" XPS, face -4.06; airspace 6.000-4.060 = 1.940 in; brick to studs 6.500 in against the note's 2024 W2.8 row of 6.625 in (0.125 in margin). A mason who builds the printed '4" air' puts the wythe 2.06 in further out (brick to stud ~8.6 in), outside that W2.8 row and off the beam the wythe bears on.
evidence.expected: K7 reads '1.94" drained cavity; brick back face 6.00" off the sheathing/curb face; no EPS', matching the ladder and the veneer-cavity check.
evidence.method: pdftotext -f 66/139/140 permit_set_full.pdf | grep -n 'K7'; envelope_masonry.py:57; sunken_garden_veneer_beam.md:905-925 (house note, cites IRC 2024 Table R703.8.4(1) W2.8 row; I did not re-read the code table).

findings.proposed_fix: Rewrite K7 in both notes (and the line 74 prose) to 1.94" / no EPS; scope the A-588/589 line with the existing {*GARDEN_CURB*} glob.

findings.title: East and west elevations call the roof 'CDX-PLYWOOD'; the visible roof skin is Image II standing seam (standing-seam-linen-white)

evidence.measured: pdftotext p36/p37 bbox: leader word 'CDX-PLYWOOD' at the roof band (x 821..868, y 233). model.json catalog ROOF layers: spf 11.875, cdx-plywood 0.594, roof-adhered-butyl-ht 0.03, standing-seam-linen-white 1.0 (outermost). elevation_project.py:418-427 sets candidate.material_ref from whichever PART has the smallest vertex depth toward the eye; the deck oversails the roofing setbacks (layer_edge_setbacks), so the CDX part wins and _material_callouts (elevation_annotate.py:401) prints its name for the whole roof facade. A-201/A-202 do not show the roof plane, so only the two side elevations misprint.
evidence.expected: ROOF callout reads the outermost layer by layer order (STANDING-SEAM-LINEN-WHITE, or 'IMAGE II 24 GA PVDF'), as it does for the walls.
evidence.method: pdftotext -f 36 -l 37 -bbox permit_set_full.pdf | grep CDX; python: next(a for a in model.json catalog.assemblies if a['tag']=='ROOF')['layers'].

findings.source: model.json catalog ROOF assembly; RF-HOUSE roof panel params (params/roof_panel.py)
findings.proposed_fix: Choose the callout material from the outermost layer (by layer index or LayerFunction.ROOFING) when the candidate kind is roof, not by nearest vertex.
